newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australis, Optus appoint CEO for jv.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australis, Optus appoint CEO for jv.

text.p: Pay television operators Australis Media Ltd and Optus Vision said on Monday they had appointed Bill Blamires chief executive officer of the satellite infrastructure joint venture between the two companies.

Blamires was formerly corporate treasurer of Australis, the companies said in a joint statement. The companies also announced the appointment of Paul Moroney as chief financial officer of the venture. Moroney was previously Optus Vision's commercial manager of New South Wales.
The joint venture will provide management and technical services for satellite delivery of Optus and Australis services.
